invariants.statement: Application start -> auth/guest -> character detect -> create/load -> home -> gameplay -> persist -> reload -> re-auth: the entry chain is a single canonical sequence; a reload at any point restores a coherent state or cleanly restarts creation - never half-written player state
quit/pagehide/unload ordering: pending writes complete or are explicitly abandoned - a reload never observes a torn write
Canonical identity = (path,way) pair: paths exactly {sword,spell,body}, ways exactly the six *_pathway ids; no legacy Vietnamese path id is a second identity authority anywhere
New chars: base stats 1/1/1/1/1 + name + starting talent + one of {tram,linh_bao,huy_quyen}; every legal pick produces a combat-ready character; no implicit tram repair
CURRENT_SAVE_VERSION=87: accepts current shape; older versions reject cleanly; no retired-field resurrection; failed validation = zero partial restoration across ALL live owners
Every persisted field a consumer reads is shape-validated; persistentTimedEffects.cultivationSpeedPercent/effectGroup checked (F-MG-22 class) - crafted NaN/negative inputs cannot reach fold math
Cloud reconcile must never regress to an older lineage: save_revision counters that diverge per device cannot order writes (F-MG-18) - pull/push ordering + CAS guard preserve newest state
Foundation gate: LQ level 12 + chapter qi_refining_abyssal_pool cleared; realm settlement exactly-once; defeat/cooldown/replay cannot double-apply or skip
hiddenPerfection lineage is a strict prefix ordered by realm; normal breakthrough closes it permanently; completed hidden rewards never repeat
Every BodyProgression transaction is exactly-once with exact resource debit or zero change; physique transformation fires once at canonical checkpoint; reload never advances twice
Technique = canonical holder: grade/rank/mastery/quality/gradeHistory under frozen-cycle model 0..18; mastery only from authorized sources - never from defeat/abort/visual/dup settlement
Core Node Level is the sole skill-level authority: no independent Skill.level/persisted skillLevels; every Beta levelled skill's runtime effect derives from canonical core level
Each of the six ways' kit identity matches its authored contract: sword basic-only+orbs+combo; hidden ways fixed-kit; spell element state isolated to spell way; body HP-cost/reflect semantics
Battle outcome + reward settlement happen exactly once per battle: invocation/event cardinality enforced; abort/teardown/mid-cast death/restart cannot duplicate or drop settlement

Presentation releases pending domain impact at authored markers; it is never a second authority for damage/reward; visual failure (missing/stale/dup token, no ACK, scene switch, missing asset, zero-frame) cannot double-deal, skip, or resurrect callbacks

buff/reaction/ailment/proc/follow-up/reflect/control systems: apply/refresh/stack/expiry/dispel ownership correct on death/repeat; spell element mechanics never leak to sword/body via shared helpers; invocation cardinality exact

Stat pipeline: base+body+physique+talent+equipment+realm+technique+way+combat deltas ordered and provenance-tracked; no double-apply/stale/wrong-domain/foreign-way leak; HP/maxHP coherent; reload no re-apply
Talent lifecycle: creation pick + breakthrough entitlement + NEW/UPGRADE offers - every offered option individually legal; pending entitlement blocks progress; no forged/foreign/zero-weight member
Item/material/currency transactions conserve: source not destroyed unless output accepted per contract; capacity boundaries; partial/zero/duplicate delivery safe; paid preview cannot replay
Equipment: drop->affix->bag->equip->enhance->refine->wash->dissolve->save; failed txn never partially consumes; one instance in one slot; stat contribution bound to equipped state (no ghost)
Beta economy graph closes: every sink has a reachable source, every mandatory material obtainable at intended realm; no infinite loop; no deferred-still-producing; duplicate tick impossible

offline/auto-farm/world-tick/live give equivalent canonical outcomes (rewards/mastery/progress/resources/kills); offline prices the window at the rate actually held (F-MG-21 class); clock-jump/negative-ts/repeat-collection safe
Companions: Foundation-unlock, gift claim once, no duplicate companion/payout, no premature mortal/qi exposure; formation: no duplicate combatant slotting, stale member safe
Artifact is deferred past Beta: no Foundation grant/wheel/dependency/drop/stat leak onto a clean Beta character; dormant code presence is not a defect

For every Beta action: UI eligibility == domain eligibility == commit eligibility; disabled-button bypass impossible; always-reject green button is a defect; retired authority (loadout/technique-progression/route/body-fields) absent from UI

Presentation identity correct at every surface: nameplate via authored name; cultivate texture way-keyed wherever the pose renders (F-MG-19); visualArmed is mortal-scoped (F-MG-25); deleted-art references absent
Audio: cue resolution safe; missing asset slot fails silently by design (no exception); buses/routes wired; settings persist; no duplicate cue spam; listeners cleaned; gesture unlock
Phaser lifecycle: battle N never inherits battle N-1 transient state; listeners/timers/tweens/sprites/receipts torn down on shutdown/restart; resize/layers correct

Registries: no duplicate IDs, dangling refs, illegal enums/realm/way, orphan cores, impossible prereq cycles, hidden-in-normal catalog, post-Beta-required-by-Beta, asset descriptors pointing at missing files

The test suite actually detects: tests assert live owners not inputs; no self-mocking oracles; idempotent-final-only masking invocation dupes; deliberate semantic mutation of each critical invariant kills a test for the intended reason

Locally-held untracked art stays local (user requirement): zero runtime-referenced assets must be missing from the tracked tree; a runtime path referencing an untracked/committed-missing file is a defect

findings.title: [carried F-MG-18] Cloud reconcile ordering loses progress under device divergence (save_revision is a per-device write counter, not a shared sequence)
findings.counterexample: device B away 2mo at rev400 stale; A pulls rev115->plays to 130; B remoteAhead=(130>400)=false -> pushes stale at 400; A next login pulls stale -> loses progress since divergence
findings.expected: cloud sync never regresses to an older revision / newest-wins reconcile
findings.actual: per-device counter cannot order divergent lineages; CAS is sound but ordering key wrong
findings.rootCause: revision-first ordering assumes linear lineage; divergence undetectable by count

findings.title: [carried F-MG-19] PlayerPortrait bypasses CULTIVATE_TEXTURE_OVERRIDES - hidden_spell_pathway player sees phap_tu ngu-hanh cultivate art instead of van-dao on home figure + RealmPanel

findings.actual: img path never consults way/override map

findings.title: [carried F-MG-21] Offline un-buff derivation divides saved cPS by percent at SAVE time while cPS was folded at LAST-TICK percent - buff flipping in the gap mis-folds the whole offline window
findings.counterexample: expiry between last tick and save -> +25% over-grant; activation -> ~-20% under-grant, scaled by offline duration
findings.expected: offline accrual prices the window at the rate actually held
findings.actual: denominator percentAtSave != numerator's folded percent when a buff flips in the sub-tick gap
findings.rootCause: saved snapshot lacks the percent that was actually folded

findings.title: [carried F-MG-22] saveShapeValidation does not check persistentTimedEffects.cultivationSpeedPercent/effectGroup - crafted save yields Infinity/NaN unbuffed rate -> NaN cultivation (permanent progression corruption)

findings.expected: every field a new consumer trusts is shape-validated
findings.rootCause: new divide sink added without extending the validator

findings.title: [carried F-MG-23] Conditioned per_second passives fail open out of battle (hpReader undefined) - both complementary legs accumulate to cap; stat surfaces display combat band while idle

findings.title: [carried F-MG-24] Pull writes revision key before save key - exception in the 2-setItem window leaves revision=N + stale payload; later push writes stale lineage at N+1 (pulled payload lost)

findings.expected: a pulled remote payload is either fully adopted or safely re-pulled
findings.actual: revision persists while payload stays stale; self-heals only via equal-revision tie-break path
findings.rootCause: write order chosen for crash-safe claim but payload-first would be safer
